qualifiers.condition: restores from the Archive Access and Deep Archive Access tiers; increased restoration limits through AWS Support

evidence.quote: You can restore archived objects with up to 1,000 transactions per second (TPS) of object restore requests per account per AWS Region from S3 Intelligent-Tiering Archive Access, and S3 Intelligent-Tiering Deep Archive Access.
If you require increased restoration limits, you can contact AWS Support.
